The '''Krakana's Maw''', also known as the '''Maw''', was a range of [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. The highest peak in the range was known as [[Mt. Hugo]] and was the seat of the [[Bartyn mansion]].

In a certain point of the Maw, there was an open ventilation shaft, which led to the inside of [[ORO Mining Station LM0228]]. This tunnel was discovered by the [[Menahuun]] and used to sneak into the mines.

Around [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]], [[Administrator (ORO)|Administrator]] [[Guther Bartyn]] was hunting and, following a [[krugga deer]], reached the Maw; once there, he was attacked by defenses of the mines. Bartyn assumed that a number of outlaws were hiding in the mountains.

Some time around [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], two escorts working for [[Miss Mylla's Saloon]] disappeared in the lowlands of the Maw along with their customer. [[Miss Mylla]] recognized that, while she was worried, this situation had happened before.
